bio: 🇧🇷 Nº1 em Render com IA no Brasil 💎 4ª Edição do Workshop Render com IA 👇 Lote promocional aberto
bio_source: Threads profile https://www.threads.com/@montani3d (WebFetch 2026-09-25; text as returned by the fetch tool). The Instagram bio itself was not verified, but the Threads bio promotes the current (4th) workshop edition, which matches the live landing page.
index_source: Not a search index. These counts come from the public Instagram embed page https://www.instagram.com/reel/DULe4AKkfl7/embed/captioned/, fetched by the project pipeline on 2026-09-25 (data/raw/reels/cover_r03_036.json). Rounded, as displayed at fetch time.

offers.label: Workshop Render com IA, 4th edition: live on Zoom, 19-20 September, 2 days (09h30-17h30). 'Lote promocional: De R$97,00 por: R$29,90 à vista'. Includes a certificate, an 'Apostila de acompanhamento' (workbook) and 'Agentes de IA para render'.
Hotmart checkout for the workshop ticket
Workshop recordings (replay), sold separately: 'R$197,00', 1-year access, on sale until 07 November
'Formação Render.IA': an intensive AI-render training program, pitched during the workshop ('5% do tempo vendendo a Formação completa'). Price UNKNOWN.

Montani 3D Studio services: photorealistic 3D rendering, 360° images, animations, virtual tours, humanized floor plans, and a monthly 3D image retainer ('Assessoria de imagens e serviços 3D mensal') for architecture firms. Quotes via WhatsApp.
WhatsApp support for workshop questions (landing page)
Linktree (found via the guessed URL, not seen on the profile): WhatsApp, Behance portfolio, LinkedIn, Instagram

monetization_evidence.evidence: The landing page sells a paid live workshop through Hotmart: 'Lote promocional De R$97,00 por: R$29,90 à vista', '19 e 20 de setembro | NO ZOOM | AO VIVO', '+10.000 PARTICIPANTES'. It uses scarcity copy ('ÚLTIMO DIA · AS INSCRIÇÕES ENCERRAM HOJE', '95% DOS INGRESSOS VENDIDOS DO LOTE PROMOCIONAL').

Replay upsell: 'você poderá adquirir o acesso às gravações separadamente por R$197,00'. Back-end program: 'iremos oferecer uma grande oportunidade para a Formação Render.IA, nosso treinamento intensivo ... 5% do tempo vendendo a Formação completa'.

Comment-keyword funnel. Reels DUannSokdQD and DULe4AKkfl7 open with 'Comente WORKSHOP 👇'. The project's public embed fetch of DULe4AKkfl7 showed '11,257 likes' and '9,025 comments', a comment-to-like ratio of about 0.8. That fits keyword-triggered DM automation, though this is an inference: no automation tool was observed.

3D/AI render studio. Workshop page: 'Os mesmos criativos que nos fizeram vender contratos de renderização de até R$ 80 mil reais – e atender em mais de 20 países.' Studio site: 'Atendemos 10 países, incluindo Emirados Árabes, Austrália, Indonésia, EUA e Irlanda' and monthly 3D retainers for architecture firms. These are self-claims.

The studio site sells Instagram exposure as part of its service: 'A Montani 3D Studio impulsiona a visibilidade de projetos no Instagram e possui um perfil com mais de 250 mil seguidores', plus reposts by '@arq_designer com mais de 3,5 milhões de seguidores, @arqprestige com mais de 1,6 milhões e @fachadasincriveis com mais de 400 mil'. The 250K figure is out of date compared with the 603K from the embed.

Under 'Marcas que confiam na Montani 3D', the workshop page shows logos with alt text: Audi Brasil, Dalberaguero, Dame Dream, Filipo Madeira, Geison Borges, Mariana Maran, Pablo Marçal, Rafael Fernandes. These are client or endorsement claims; the kind of relationship (paid client work vs. sponsorship) is UNKNOWN.

content_mode_evidence: The captions state AI production. DULe4AKkfl7: 'E aprenda a transformar os seus renders em vídeos incríveis como esse usando apenas IA. 👀'. DUannSokdQD: 'transformar seus projetos ou fotos em vídeos incríveis como esse usand…'. DTsR_g4kfQj: 'Com essa tecnologia🤖, eu transformo uma única foto em várias versões conceituais do ambiente.'. DXwWo-7RwTl: 'A inteligência artificial abriu um novo nível no paisagismo'. The DULe4AKkfl7 cover reads 'RENDER COM IA', and the project coded it ai_generated (ESTIMATED). The inputs are 3D renders or photos that AI turns into video or variations.
niche_focus: AI rendering for architecture, interiors and landscaping (render/photo-to-video, concept variations, construction timelapses) aimed at Brazilian architects and 3D artists. Reels funnel viewers to a low-ticket paid workshop, then an AI-render training program and studio services.
cta_pattern: Comment-keyword funnel: the first caption line is 'Comente WORKSHOP 👇', followed by a promise ('E aprenda a transformar ... usando apenas IA'). The bio says '4ª Edição do Workshop Render com IA 👇 Lote promocional aberto' and links to a landing page with a countdown and scarcity copy and a Hotmart checkout.

notes: LIMITATION: the session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was already used up, so the prescribed WebSearch steps (Instagram-snippet bio/follower lookup, paid-partnership/storefront searches and the 3 reel-shortcode searches) could not run. Data comes from WebFetch of public non-Instagram pages (Threads, Linktree, own websites), and from this project's existing dataset (public Instagram topic pages + public embed pages collected earlier on 2026-09-25). instagram.com was not fetched in this step. Founder named on the landing page: Luiz Montani, 'Arquiteto, Artista 3D e Fundador do Studio 3D para o alto padrão mais seguido do mundo', who 'Conquistou mais de 700 mil seguidores em suas redes sociais e mais de 100 milhões de visualizações orgânicas'. In the HTML the number is split into '70' + '0 mil', so it reads as 700 thousand, across all networks. That is a self-claim. Threads shows 70.2K followers, a Threads-only count. Sample reel views as shown on public topic pages: DUannSokdQD 946K (2026-02-06), DXwWo-7RwTl 870K (2026-04-30), DULe4AKkfl7 499K (2026-01-31), DTsR_g4kfQj 139K (2026-01-19). The workshop was dated 19-20 September, but on 2026-09-25 the page still showed 'ÚLTIMO DIA' with a countdown, which may be an evergreen countdown (UNKNOWN). account_type is education_course because the bio and captions push the workshop; designer_studio (a 3D/AI render studio selling client renders) is a strong second. No income estimate was seen. No Instagram 'Paid partnership' posts could be checked.
